executionApproach.notes: Execution and exploration are driven by Claude Code through the Claude in Chrome extension on BrowserStack App Live. App Automate/Appium (wdio.conf.js) is kept but NOT required.

git.note: Needed only to clone/push the repository.

manual: Claude Code installed and opened in the project folder
Google Chrome with the Claude in Chrome extension connected to Claude Code
User logged in to BrowserStack (App Live access) in that Chrome profile

moduleDependencies._note: Flows that must run first when executing a single module (codes as in TC IDs).

apps._note: App registry. Banni is the default: everything above (env, requiredPaths, moduleDependencies, requiresExplicitApproval) describes Banni. Other apps are selected explicitly with --app <id> and keep their own config, inventory and artifact paths.

saagane.name: Saagane by Siddaganga
saagane.description: Internal operations app (Superadmin, Admin). Test Superadmin first, then Admin separately.
saagane.buildSelection: Latest Saagane APK in BrowserStack App Live (Uploaded Apps). Not stored locally.

moduleDependencies._note: To be defined from Saagane exploration (module codes as in its TC IDs).

Sending notifications, messages or reports to customers or staff
Password resets, OTP requests or account registrations
Deleting apps or data on BrowserStack
Creating Jira tickets or any other external posting
